features: Integrated smart smoke / gas detector with fire alarm
1080P Wi-Fi security camera in a smoke-detector housing
instant fire / smoke alerts pushed to the app
positioned for kitchens, warehouses and elder-care rooms

frigate.notes: Vstarcam standard RTSP path (port 10554, /tcp/av0_0 main, /tcp/av0_1 sub); not restated on this product page. Enable RTSP/ONVIF in the O-KAM/Eye4 app and verify on device.

home_assistant.notes: Vstarcam ONVIF/RTSP-capable line. If ONVIF auto-discovery fails, add as generic RTSP with the port-10554 path.
